candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware relaxation with downstream protection. When pipeline is high relative to recent demand, reduce orders modestly to avoid excess inventory cost; but never cut when downstream backlog is present, and boost when pipeline is low and backlog exists. This coordinates all nodes via shared state features.

rules.when: pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog < 1 and recent > 0
pipeline < recent and backlog > 0 and recent > 0
pipeline > 2 * recent and backlog >= 1 and recent > 0

candidates.explanation: Backlog-sensitive smoothing. Increase orders when backlog is high and pipeline is low to restore service; reduce cautiously when pipeline already covers demand and no backlog. Guards prevent division by zero and limit corrections to small values.

rules.when: backlog > 2 * recent and pipeline < recent and recent > 0
backlog > 0 and pipeline < 1.5 * recent and recent > 0
pipeline > 2.5 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0

candidates.explanation: Growth-adaptive damping. When recent demand exceeds baseline, slightly increase orders to avoid stockouts; when pipeline is excessive relative to growth, reduce cautiously. Keeps corrections small and coordinated across nodes.

rules.when: growth > 1.2 and pipeline < recent and backlog > 0 and recent > 0
growth < 0.8 and pipeline > 2 * recent and recent > 0
pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0
